```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir<-"../2026-01-27_out"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

files<-c("treemap_class-aves_color-order_label-common.png",
         "treemap_class-mammal_color-order_label-common.png")

paths<-path(img_dir,files)

# helper
img_to_gg<-function(img_path){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

if(any(!file_exists(paths))){
  message("Missing:\n",paste(paths[!file_exists(paths)],collapse="\n"))
}else{

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=1,nrow=2,
                  labels=c("A","B"),
                  label_size=16,
                  label_x=0.02,
                  label_y=0.98,
                  hjust=0,
                  vjust=1)

  out_name<-"treemap_class_aves_vs_mammal_comp_long.png"
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)

  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=3.5,height=4.2,dpi=300,bg="white")
  message("Wrote: ",out_file)
}
```
